content.title: Inspection Scheduling Instructions and Automated Phone Codes
content.summary: Inspections can be scheduled, canceled, or checked via text by sending specific commands to 866-783-1447, using the format \"S\" for scheduling, \"C\" for cancellation, and \"R\" for results, followed by the permit number and inspection code. A comprehensive list of inspection codes is provided for various categories, including building, engineering, traffic, and stormwater. For further assistance, contact the Building Inspections at (720) 898-7620 or Engineering Inspections at (720) 898-7640.
content.body:
## Schedule Inspections in Text Messages

- **Text phone number:**[866-783-1447](tel:8667831447)
- **Use S to Schedule, C to cancel, and R to check results**
  - **To Schedule, text:****S** [space] **Permit Number** [space] **Inspection Code**.   
    Example: S ROOF24-00164 100
  - **To Cancel, text:****C** [space] **Permit Number** [space] **Inspection Code**.   
    Example: C ROOF24-00164 100
  - **To Check Results, text:****R** [space] **Permit Number** [space] **Inspection Code**.   
    Example: R ROOF24-00164 100
- Or send a text to [**866-783-1447**](tel:8667831447) with just one word and then follow the prompts to enter your permit number and inspection code:
  - **Schedule**to schedule an inspection
  - **Reschedule**to reschedule an inspection
  - **Cancel**to cancel an inspection
  - **Results** to obtain inspection results
